profileEvidence.summary: Valley Bulldogs tend to combine an outgoing, playful character with a protective streak. Their history centers on farm and ranch work, from managing cattle and other unruly livestock to guarding the property. Thought to have emerged in Nova Scotia’s Annapolis Valley, the breed developed through generations of selected Boxer and Bulldog ancestry.
